name: Tarp & Tinder
tagline: Wild camping and bushcraft skills, one night at a time
about: Tarp & Tinder teaches wild camping and bushcraft: finding a legal, low-impact pitch, tarp and hammock rigs for the weather, fire lays that light in the damp, water sourcing and treatment, and what to do when the map stops making sense.
persona: You are a bushcraft instructor and mountain-rescue volunteer: patient, hands-on, leave-no-trace to the bone, and never casual about fire, water or hypothermia.

onboarding.title: Sleep out, leave nothing
onboarding.subtitle: Your kit and experience shape every plan.
bullets: Tarp rigs and fire lays for real weather

profile.label: Kit
profile.placeholder: ferro rod, folding saw, 3x3 tarp, squeeze filter

tools.title: Find a pitch
tools.subtitle: Photo or description → yes/no and why

inputs.label: Describe the spot
inputs.placeholder: beech wood above a stream, 200 m from a footpath, gentle slope

tools.prompt: Assess this wild-camp spot: {spot} (use the photo if attached) in {region}. A text verdict on the spot, a table of checks (Check | Pass / Fail | Why) covering water, deadfall, flood, wind, visibility and distance from homes and paths, a callout on the general access rules for the region in plain language (verify locally), and a checklist for leaving no trace at dawn.

tools.title: Rig for the weather
tools.subtitle: Tarp / hammock configurations

inputs.label: Tonight's weather
inputs.placeholder: rain then clearing, 25 mph gusts from SW, 4°C

inputs.label: What's around
inputs.placeholder: two oaks 4 m apart, no big rocks

tools.prompt: Choose a rig for the profile's shelter given '{weather}' and surroundings '{trees}'. Sections: kv (configuration name, pitch height, door orientation, ridge type, minimum pegs and lines), steps to set it up naming the knot for each attachment point, bullets of the knots to practise, and a callout on condensation and cold from below.

tools.title: Light a fire that stays lit
tools.subtitle: Tinder, lay and safety for the conditions
tools.prompt: Fire plan for {conditions} conditions, purpose: {purpose}, with the profile kit. A table of tinder and kindling to gather (Material | Where to find it | How to prep), steps for the lay and ignition in order, a checklist for site prep and full extinguishment, and a callout on when NOT to light one (bans, peat, wind, dry grass).

tools.title: Water plan
tools.subtitle: Source, treat, carry

inputs.label: Water sources on route
inputs.placeholder: stream below camp, a small lochan, farm run-off above

inputs.label: Hours until the next reliable source

tools.prompt: Plan water with the profile kit: sources are {sources}, next reliable source in {hours} hours. A table (Source | Risk | Treatment method | Time), kv (litres to carry, litres per hour of walking, reserve), steps for the treatment method that fits the kit, and a callout on what no filter removes.

tools.title: Map stopped making sense
tools.subtitle: Calm, stepwise relocation

inputs.label: What you know
inputs.placeholder: left the ridge path 40 min ago, heading roughly NE, stream on my left

tools.prompt: Relocate calmly: {known}; conditions: {light}. Steps in the STOP order (stop, think, observe, plan) with concrete things to check at each, bullets of natural-navigation clues to use, a kv decision (keep moving / hold and shelter / call for help, with the reason), and a callout on what to tell rescue if you call.

disclaimer: Outdoor guidance is general; conditions and laws vary. Check local access and fire rules and always carry the means to call for help.
